zoneNotes: While Oceanic Vortex bubbles are available to fish from in the Voidstorm, these can be difficult to find, and do not appear to grant Fishing Skill levels. There are green open-water sources to fish from in the Voidscar Arena, in the northern area of the zone.
While you can fish in Quel'danas, there isn't any advantage to doing so. There are no pools off Quel'danas, and the open-water fishing is nearly identical to what you will find in Eversong.

pools.name: Bloom Swarm
pools.note: Bloom Swarms are short-lived, usually only good for 1 cast. However, they yield only Uncommon and Rare fish.

pools.name: Oceanic Vortex
pools.note: Oceanic Vortexes are extremely rare fishing nodes in Voidstorm. They are purple bubbles and are not flagged on the map by Find Fish. 300 Fishing alone isn't enough; it may require high Perception to see them consistently. You can use an Angler's Anomaly (usually fished from treasure pools) to summon one anywhere. These do last a great deal longer than pools. All fish you can fish for in Oceanic Vortexes are also available in the easier-to-find Viscous Void pools.

pools.name: Careless Cargo
pools.note: Primary source for Fishing Lure recipes, Recipe: Amani Angler's Ward, component items used to create Midnight Angler's Grand Line, as well as Motes and other treasures.

pools.name: Lost Treasures
pools.note: Rare node; little information has been collected. Mostly seems to yield normal fish at lower levels. May require high Perception/fishing skill to get actual treasures. Usually a one-and-done node.

pools.name: Viscous Void
pools.note: Consistent (and much safer) place to fish for species native to Voidstorm. Any fish you can get from an Oceanic Vortex, you can also get from a Viscous Void pool. The only drawback is high competition.

extras.title: Treasures
extras.text: Abyss Angler's Fish Log - Found in object 539049 inside a cave in Zul'Aman, Bait and Tackle The following fishing-related items are fished up primarily from Careless Cargo and Lost Treasures pools, but can occasionally be found in others: An Angler's Deep Dive - Increases Midnight fishing skill by 10. Also looted from Patient Treasure chests Angler's Anomaly - allows you to create an Oceanic Vortex pool in any zone. Save these for when your fishing skill is well past 200, when points are much harder to come by.

extras.title: Midnight Angler's Grand Line
extras.text: Midnight Angler's Grand Line is created out of fish components and does not require any other profession skill to create. This binds to Warband, so you can have your top fishing character make it and send it to alts. It's similar in practice to the Algari Weaverline from TWW, except that it doesn't require Tailoring, it applies only to giving you double Treasures, and doesn't improve skill or Perception. The last part is actually not as bad as it sounds, because the Algari Weaverline in TWW did not stack with Perception buffs (and there are a lot of Perception buffs for fishing in Midnight). To apply a fishing line, open your fishing profession journal, right-click the line, and then click on your pole. You will need a separate line for each fishing pole you use. The Midnight Great Angler's Line and all its components can be traded or sold on the Auction House. To create the Midnight Gre

extras.title: Patient Treasures
extras.text: Occasionally, when you are fishing, you will get a random spawn of a Patient Treasure chest. These can contain several items, including the Bubbly Snapling pet, +Fishing items such as An Angler's Deep Dive, Bloomline and Glimmerline pieces, cosmetics, and lure recipes. While it usually spawns very close by, either in front or behind, it occasionally appears some distance away. If you don't see it right next to you, look around in the immediate area.

extras.title: Nether-Warped Egg
extras.text: While Nether-Warped Egg can be found within the above-mentioned treasure chests, Eggs can also be fished from the open-water areas of Slayer's Rise in Voidstorm. [h2 type=bar toc="Collectibles"]Fishing-Exclusive Collectibles[/h2]

extras.title: Mounts
extras.text: After finding the Nether-Warped Egg and waiting for 7 days, it will hatch into the Nether-Swept Drake.

changes121.text: Midnight 12.1 Fishing Changes[/h2] Compared to other professions, Fishing has the most exciting changes in Patch 12.1, including new reagents, new lures, and a brand new Fishing Rod, The Coiled Huntress. Cursed Fishing, a new buff that allows players to catch unique fish in the Coiled Isle, requires the use of the new Curse Surge mechanics. After a Curse Surge has been completed, the surrounding area will be affected by Cursed Fishing. When this buff is active, you will be able to fish up unique fish and reagents, such as Neutralized Venom Clot and Cursebound Globe, from fishing in the affected area. Additionally, a brand new faction, faction 2773, has been introduced. As you improve your reputation with the Captain, you will unlock Temple Fishing and Venom Fishing, giving you more areas and options to fish in within the Coiled Isle. You will receive brand new reagents like Polluted Puffer which are used in newly added Cooking recipes. Once you reach the highest reputation with Captain Tokka, you will be able to purchase the The Coiled Huntress for 6000 Voidlight Marl. To learn more about Cursed Fishing and Captain Tokka, check out our standalone guide: New Fish added in Patch 12.1
